title: The godfather
summary: Your oldest mate, whose best man you were, has a baby girl. He wants you to be godfather. The christening is a Sunday morning after an away game at the other end of the country.

ends.title: Her godfather
ends.text: You're godfather to your oldest mate's daughter. She calls you by your squad number.

ends.title: The card
ends.text: You missed the christening and sent a card. You've been to every birthday since.

p-christening.text: Be at the christening of {pal.short}'s baby

kept.text: You stand at the font in yesterday's suit. {pal.short} keeps mouthing "you came" over the vicar.

broken.text: "We held it ten minutes for you. Vicar had a wedding after."

p-christening.remind: "Half ten Sunday. She's got a dress and everything. {pal.short}"

beats.title: The baby

event.title: The baby
event.speaker: pal
setup: {pal.short} brings the baby round in a car seat and puts her on your kitchen table like a trophy. "Godfather. Sunday the fourteenth, half ten."

say: You check the fixtures in your head. Saturday the thirteenth, away, five hours up the motorway.

replies.label: "I'll be there if I have to drive all night."
"I'll try. You know what Saturdays are."
"Do I have to do a speech? Last time..."

yes.text: He says the vicar is a fan of the other lot, so wear something plain.

try.text: "Try," he says, and picks up the car seat.

speech.text: "No speeches," he says. "She heard about the last one."

beats.hint: Your oldest mate wants you as godfather

event.title: Five hours up the motorway
event.speaker: pal
setup: Saturday night, after the game, a hotel car park five hours from home. The christening is at half ten in the morning.

outcomes.text: You get in at four, sleep three hours in the car outside the church and go in with your tie in your pocket.

choices.label: Sleep at the hotel. Text him in the morning.

outcomes.text: You wake at ten past ten with the phone on the floor. Four missed calls from {pal.short}.

event.title: Her first birthday
event.speaker: pal
setup: A season on. A birthday party in a church hall, a cake shaped like a one, and a little girl in a football shirt.
{if mem(pal,'missed-the-christening'|'slept-through-the-christening')}There's a photo of the christening on the wall. You're not in it.{/if}

outcomes.text: She's in your shirt, with your number. She points at you and says it, the number, not your name.
You weren't at the christening. You're at this. She sits on your knee for the photo.
A ball as big as she is. {pal.short} sends a video of her sitting on it.
A ball and a card. Same as the christening.
